name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: PARENTS: Have your child make one Valentine's Day card for each of the 22 students in the class. Leave the "To:" section blank, and only fill out the child's name. PARENTS: Keep any prizes or goodies small, as the decorated bags are too small for large items.

name: Sports-Themed Shirt Spirit Day
description: PARENTS: Send child in sports-themed shirt

name: Field Trip to Hidden Villa Farms
description: PARENTS: Please sign up on the Google Doc if you plan to chaperone! I will need to let the office know who is attending ahead of time and it will make this process smooth for me.

name: PTA General Meeting
description: Join us for our next PTA meeting!

name: Yearbook Cover Contest (5th Graders Only)
description: Entries due by February 23, 2026. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel.

name: NOWRUZ (IRANIAN NEW YEAR) STAFF LUNCHEON
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: Variety Show – Volunteers & Important Info
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands and Concession Organizer. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To Apply to the Variety Show, sign up to perform by Sunday, March 1st, 2026. Dress Rehearsal is on Thursday, March 19th, 2026 at 4:00 PM and the Show is on Friday, March 20th, 2026 at 4:00 PM.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place on Friday April 24th from 4-7pm. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!!

name: Castillero PTA Volunteers Needed
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.

name: Yearbook Photo Submission Deadline
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st. Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.
